summary: plan.md is written: the twin-leg Art Deco south tower (fluted, stepped legs; four portal struts with stepped, recessed frames; an X brace under the deck; red-lit caps over the cable saddles) on a grey pier inside an elliptical fender. The deck module tiles every 16 blocks with a Warren truss, an orange railing and lamps. Both cable modules follow the given curves to half a block (slab on top), with cable bands and thin red suspender lines. It reads as the Golden Gate from the tower outline, the International Orange (terracotta), the cable curves and the suspender rows; every block id passes the check, but nothing was built or rendered.
